sources.entry: Deep-Live-Cam - A repository that offers tools to create deepfake videos using live camera input, providing real-time face-swapping capabilities.

summary.one_liner: Deep-Live-Cam is an open-source desktop tool that swaps faces in live webcam feeds and in image or video files using a single source face image.
keywords: swap faces on webcam for video calls
use one photo to change face live
use_cases: Swap a face live on a webcam for streaming or shows
Replace a face in a recorded video or image
Map different faces onto multiple people in one frame
Animate custom characters or artwork with a face
Create memes using a single photo
how_to_run: git clone --depth 1 <repository URL> (URL missing from README text)
Download gfpgan-1024.onnx and inswapper_128_fp16.onnx into the models folder
python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\activate (Windows) or source venv/bin/activate (Linux/macOS)
python run.py (add --execution-provider cuda, coreml, dml, or openvino for GPU/accelerated use)
stack: CUDA, CoreML, DirectML, OpenVINO execution providers
notable: Live webcam mode: select a source face, pick a camera, and stream the output via a screen capture tool such as OBS
Mouth Mask option keeps the original mouth movement
Many-faces and face-mapping modes swap different faces on multiple subjects at once
Multiple hardware backends: CPU, Nvidia CUDA, Apple CoreML, Windows DirectML, and Intel OpenVINO
Command-line mode is available via -s/--source, though the README marks the CLI as unmaintained
caveats: The README says manual installation requires technical skill and is not for beginners; it recommends a pre-built version instead
The README includes a built-in content filter for nudity and graphic material, and says the project may be shut down or add watermarks if legally required
The README says the insightface models are for non-commercial research use only
The README warns that other download sites for pre-built versions may be unsafe, and that only the official website and this repo are trusted
The initial run downloads about 300MB of models; the README says CPU use is slower than GPU
